phase: Restore server-authoritative report/challenge counts for the profile page. Root cause: the client read ai_reports/challenge_records directly via wx.cloud.database().where({openid}).count(), but those rows are written by cloud functions and carry no _openid, so under the default collection rule the query only sees creator rows -> always 0. Fix: new read-only cloud function getProfileStats resolves identity from cloud.getWXContext().OPENID (never trusts client openid) and returns canonical counts (reportCount via the report-history visibility rule, challengeCount, challengeFinishedCount, paidReportCount); the profile page consumes it and distinguishes ZERO (confirmed 0) from UNKNOWN (—) from ERROR (retry, preserve last valid). No payment function / membership / entitlement change; no historical record mutation; read-only DB queries scoped to the authenticated openid.
scope: + cloudfunctions/getProfileStats/{index.js,package.json,config.json,lib/response.js,lib/countPolicy.js} (new read-only server-authority stats fn) + cloudbaserc.json (register getProfileStats) + pages/profile/profile.js (consume getProfileStats; ZERO/UNKNOWN/ERROR semantics; drop broken direct count query) + pages/profile/profile.wxml (empty/total display) + tests/rc8.9/profile-authority.test.js (updated to new server path) + tests/rc8.13/profile-stats-authority.test.js (new) + tests/rc8.13/run.js + .changes/current-change.json.
